Well worth a download, I’ve tried a couple of “solutions” for cutting screen time and this is by far the best.

title.label: My second time reviewing - milestone achieved

content.label:
This app has changed my life, and got me my most valuable asset back: 

My time.

Since May 2023, I have saved 4.3 weeks of SCREEN TIME on Instagram, and another couple weeks across multiple different social media’s.

Across the board, I have saved 1.4 MONTHS of screen time. Just think about that for onesec (excuse the pun) 

Overall ‘app opening’ preventions currently sit at 19,701. 

In fact, my milestone has now been achieved:

The blockers were genuinely so annoying to bypass, I started to get frustrated and it clearly conditioned my brain to resent the app in question that was being blocked, in this case, Instagram. I have now uninstalled Instagram, and I can say confidently that I am much happier without it. 

You actually realise after you don’t have some of these apps that their presence in your life is meaningless, and they literally give you zero value.

The only social media app I could justify using is “X”, which I still have yet to even use, but it’s a platform of free speech and uncensored content so that you can make your own informed decisions about the world without being reliant on mainstream media. Again, just make sure you have the blockers in place & re-interventions (stops you from doomscrolling / getting you into rabbit holes for hours) 

Nevertheless, it’s actually quite scary to think that some of us can’t live without social media. It used to be me. 

The truth is, whether or not you have social media on your phone, the world keeps spinning. It’s up to you to decide what you do with your time as it spins. 

I trust you’ll make the smart decision that I did back in May last year. Install the app and get your time back. 
 
Massive thank you to the developers, hopefully one day I’ll meet you and treat you all to a drink. 

Alex
United Kingdom 
24/09/2024
